title: C# Variables
description: Variables are containers for storing data values. In C#, there are different types of variables (int, double, char, string, bool).

challenges.title: String Variable
challenges.exercise: Create a string variable named 'name' and assign the value 'John'. Print it.

challenges.title: Integer Variable
challenges.exercise: Create an int variable named 'myNum' and assign 50. Print it.

challenges.title: Adding Variables
challenges.exercise: Create x=5, y=10. Print the sum (x+y).
challenges.solution:
int x = 5; int y = 10;
Console.WriteLine(x + y);

challenges.title: Multiple Variables
challenges.exercise: Declare x=5, y=6, z=50 on the same line using commas and print the sum.
challenges.solution:
int x = 5, y = 6, z = 50;
Console.WriteLine(x + y + z);

challenges.title: Constant Variable
challenges.exercise: Use 'const' for a variable named 'pi' with value 3.14 (mock it with string '3.14'). Print it.
